page_title: AST 2-2 CHE | Aston Villa v Chelsea 27/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+10' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' Lucas Digne sends over an inswinging corner and Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) gets his head on the ball, but it goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
90+9' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

90+8' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+7' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Chelsea players look gutted.
90+6' The Chelsea players halt their celebrations as referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

90+5' Benoit Badiashile displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Axel Disasi (Chelsea) gets onto the scoresheet by superbly heading it into the roof of the net – 2:3.
90+5' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) will take the corner.

90+4' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Robin Olsen makes a decent save to deny his effort directed low to the middle of the target. The ball goes behind for a corner. Chelsea will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+2' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

90+1' Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Craig Pawson with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Thiago Silva doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Axel Disasi (Chelsea) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
90' Here comes a substitution. Mykhailo Mudryk is given a rest as he is replaced by Cesare Casadei (Chelsea).
88' The game is interrupted now, Thiago Silva (Chelsea) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
88' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thiago Silva (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner but it's cleared.

86' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Chelsea win a corner kick.

84' A rebound falls at the feet of Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa), whose promising strike from long range flies a few inches over the crossbar! What a great effort! The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
83' Substitution. Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) on for Moussa Diaby.
82' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
81' 2 - 2 Goal! Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) is teed up on the edge of the box by Noni Madueke, and his howitzer of a shot into the top left corner gives the keeper no chance. 2:2.
80' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
78' Craig Pawson has a clear sight and sees a foul from Conor Gallagher (Chelsea).

77' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
75' Here comes a substitution. Tim Iroegbunam (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Douglas Luiz.
75' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) replacing Leon Bailey.
73' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.

72' He should have scored! Noni Madueke (Chelsea) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Robin Olsen makes an easy save.
69' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
69' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
66' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) for his blatant foul.
65' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) shoots from the free kick towards the goal, but slams the ball well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
64' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Craig Pawson had an easy-decision to make.
62' 2 - 1 Goal! Conor Gallagher plays a simple square pass into the feet of Noni Madueke (Chelsea) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
62' The referee blows his whistle as Pau Torres (Aston Villa) was too aggressive in his challenge.
61' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Craig Pawson saw the whole situation.
61' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Robin Olsen has no trouble gathering it.

60' Thiago Silva (Chelsea) outbattles his marker to get a close-range header in on goal from the corner, but a defender unwittingly blocks the ball as it looked set to find the net. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
60' The referee awards a corner and Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes over to take it.
58' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
56' Chelsea control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
55' A raking crossfield pass from John McGinn (Aston Villa) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.

53' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
52' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends a poor cross in from the free kick that is cleared by the head of a defender.
51' Craig Pawson interrupts the game. One of the players from Aston Villa won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Chelsea earn a free kick.
49' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
49' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

47' Ambitious effort from Marc Cucurella (Chelsea). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
46' Emiliano Martinez is substituted due to injury. Unai Emery gives a chance to Robin Olsen (Aston Villa).
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' Craig Pawson has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' A player from Aston Villa takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) commits a foul during an attacking move.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
45' One of the players from Chelsea times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
42' 2 - 0 Matty Cash feeds the ball through to Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 2:0!
41' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Chelsea was in an offside position.
41' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
40' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Craig Pawson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Chelsea have been awarded a free kick.

39' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.

38' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
37' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Djordje Petrovic.
36' Dangerous play by Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea). Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.

34' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the right post.
32' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) whips in the free kick, but one of the defenders comfortably clears the ball away.
31' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Aston Villa.
29' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
29' Chelsea enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
27' Unai Emery is forced to make a change. Youri Tielemans is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa).
26' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) picks up an injury.
25' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez is alert and makes a decent save.
23' The percentage of ball possession is – 27:73.
22' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) makes a strong challenge and Craig Pawson blows for a foul.
20' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
18' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Chelsea players look gutted.
17' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Chelsea players aren’t happy.
16' Goal! Moises Caicedo displays great vision and sends a pass to Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:0.

16' This was a piece of cake for Djordje Petrovic. Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
14' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
11' The Chelsea players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) brings his opponent down. Craig Pawson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
7' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) commits a rough foul. Craig Pawson stops the game and makes a call.
4' 1 - 0 What bad luck! Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 1:0.
3' Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea) wins the ball from the resulting free kick but scuffs his shot well wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
1' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Aston Villa will take the kick-off.
Craig Pawson will supervise the game today.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
